SimuHire is an AI-powered automated technical interview system designed to transform the recruitment process by reducing human effort, increasing evaluation accuracy, and ensuring fairness. Traditional interview procedures involve significant manual involvement, inconsistencies in assessment, interviewer bias, and scalability issues when handling a large number of candidates. SimuHire addresses these challenges by integrating advanced artificial intelligence, natural language processing (NLP), machine learning techniques, and secure code-execution environments.

The system automatically generates domain-specific interview questions, evaluates theoretical answers using semantic similarity and contextual understanding, and conducts coding assessments in a controlled sandbox environment. It incorporates plagiarism detection mechanisms through cosine similarity, TF-IDF matching, and database comparison to ensure authenticity and integrity of candidate responses. Behavioral indicators such as clarity, relevance, and completeness are also analyzed using NLP-based scoring models. The system concludes each interview by producing a comprehensive report containing section-wise scores, coding results, plagiarism percentage, performance insights, and hiring recommendations.

SimuHire significantly minimizes human intervention while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and scalability. By reducing interviewer workload, standardizing evaluation criteria, and automating documentation, it enables organizations to conduct large-scale recruitment drives efficiently. The results demonstrate that AI-driven interview evaluation can serve as a viable alternative to traditional human-led assessments, providing unbiased, data-driven insights essential for modern hiring processes.

The evolution of artificial intelligence and cloud computing has enabled the automation of several traditionally manual business processes. One such area that has gained attention in recent years is the recruitment process. Hiring skilled professionals involves manual tasks such as scheduling interviews, designing appropriate questions, evaluating responses, and documenting results, all of which consume time and human effort. Furthermore, consistency in evaluation is often compromised due to interviewer fatigue, human bias, and varying levels of expertise among interview panelists.

SimuHire aims to revolutionize the recruitment workflow by automating the technical interview process. It leverages natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and secure cloud infrastructure to generate interview questions, evaluate candidate responses, assess coding skills, detect plagiarism, and produce structured reports. The platform behaves like a human interviewer but operates with the precision, consistency, and scalability of AI.

SimuHire is designed as a comprehensive interview management system for organizations of any size. At its core, it integrates advanced AI models capable of generating domain-specific and difficulty-specific interview questions. Candidates interact with the system through a user-friendly interface that supports both theoretical and coding assessments. The system evaluates textual responses using NLP-based keyword extraction, semantic similarity scoring, contextual understanding, and rubric-based evaluation strategies.

The coding engine allows candidates to write and execute programs in real-time. Each program is run against a set of predefined or AI-generated test cases to ensure correctness and efficiency. The system also incorporates plagiarism detection techniques using cosine similarity, TF-IDF vectorization, and API-based checks to ensure authenticity.

After the interview, SimuHire compiles a detailed report containing strengths, weaknesses, coding results, plagiarism scores, behavioral indicators, and a hiring recommendation. This reduces human workload significantly and enables scalable candidate assessments.

Recruitment is often constrained by limited time, availability of technical panelists, scheduling conflicts, and inconsistencies in evaluation. Allow thousands of candidates to attempt interviews simultaneously.
Remove human biases and ensure standardized evaluation for all applicants.

The implementation and testing of the SimuHire system produced significant findings that demonstrated the effectiveness, robustness, and practicality of integrating artificial intelligence into technical recruitment workflows. The results validate that the system not only automates key stages of the interview process but also enhances the quality and consistency of candidate evaluation when compared to traditional human-led interviews.
One of the primary components evaluated was the question generation module. The AI models successfully generated domain-specific,
difficulty-graded questions in diverse areas such as Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Operating Systems (OS), SQL, cloud fundamentals, and general aptitude.
The generated questions displayed high relevance to the selected job role.
Difficulty levels adapted accurately for beginner, intermediate, and advanced candidates.
Question repetition across candidates was minimal due to diverse generative capabilities.
This confirms that AI-based question generation can effectively replace manually curated question banks.
